## Design

### 2026-11-02: started and did a lot of the schematics for Nibble.

**2.08h**

started and did a lot of the schematics for Nibble.
I ran into a few problems: a bunch of the HC chips weren't in the KiCad library, and my lazy bum was not bothered to import them, so i just used the LS ones, which are an older variant but basically have the same schematic, so it doesn't change too much.

Completed Binary counter and capacitor, the 7 resistors, as well as 112 diodes, which took a really long time,
The schematics were so big that i decided to switch to an A3 schematic.

Next also completed the schematics for the row and opcode decoders, XOR chip, and arithmetic logic unit, the MUX, output register and the accumulator too. that's pretty much it.
